title: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 – Junior Engineer (Civil) Posts
shortInfo: JKSSB has announced notification for Junior Engineer (Civil) posts. Required qualification: Diploma, B.Tech/B.E. Last date to apply: 29-12-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Online Application Forms

howToApply: Visit the official website of JKSSB at www.jkssb.nic.in.
Read the Advertisement Notification No. 11 of 2026 carefully before applying.
Fill the Online Application Form with all required details including Name, Date of Birth, Father’s Name, Mother’s Name (as per Matriculation Certificate), Email-ID, and Mobile Number.

Upload live photograph, signature (Size: 10 KB to 20 KB), Category Certificate (Max size: 200 KB in PDF format), and Qualification/Experience Certificates (self-attested, Max size: 200 KB in PDF format) as required.
Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card (Rs. 600/- for General; Rs. 500/- for SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS, and PwBD candidates).
Submit the Online Application Form before the last date i.e. 29.12.2026.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference and for submission at the time of Document Verification.
Do not submit hard copies of the online application form to the office of the Services Selection Board either in person or by post/email.

In-service candidates shall submit the printout of the filled online application form along with a duly filled, signed, and stamped certificate through proper channel (Head of Department/Designated Authority).

howToApply: Visit the official LAHDC-KSSRB website at https://www.dssrbkargil.in.
Click on ‘New User Registration’ for one-time registration by filling Basic Details, Contact Details, and uploading scanned passport size photograph and signature in JPEG format (20KB to 100KB).
After successful registration, a User ID and Password will be sent to the registered email.
Login using the credentials and click on ‘Apply Now’ against the desired post.
Fill in the online application form carefully with all required details.
Pay the application fee online through credit card/debit card/net banking/UPI.
Submit the application form before the closing date of 27-11-2026.
Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference and for submission at the document verification stage.
Candidates must apply separately for each category of post and pay fee for each.

General, EWS and Other Backward Class (OBC) - Female / Transgender candidates

dates.event: Last Date to Apply & Pay Examination Fee

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.
